suites.title: Scenarios
suites.description: Whole founder profiles, end to end

categories.title: The known-good kit passes
categories.why: Without a passing baseline, every refusal below could be a gate that refuses everything.

categories.title: Gives advice or promises to act
categories.why: Groundwork routes and cites. A confident recommendation is unlicensed advice, and filing is a capability it does not have.

categories.title: Claims without evidence
categories.why: A citation proves a page was consulted, not that it says what the claim says.

categories.title: Answers outside its scope
categories.why: A founder it cannot serve gets a referral, not a kit. Another state’s rule must never answer a Texas question.

categories.title: Steps in an order that fails
categories.why: An EIN application filed before the entity exists fails at the IRS. Order is not cosmetic.

categories.title: Invents certainty
categories.why: An unknown stays unknown. A guessed deadline is worse than no deadline.

categories.title: Repair that spreads or never stops
categories.why: Fix only what failed, stop when it passes, and escalate rather than return a bad kit.

categories.title: Loses the record
categories.why: Months later the question is what the system saw on the day it answered.

categories.title: Rests on stale or shifted sources
categories.why: Agencies edit their pages. The specific line a claim rests on is tracked, not the page.
